title: Seasonal Share Schedule — Lease Term Agreement Exit Notice Charges
content:
The insufficient notice charge on a lease-break request against a Lease Term Agreement carries a season share set by the calendar month of the requested termination date: May through August keeps 50 percent of the charge; March, April, September or October keeps 75 percent; November through February keeps the whole.

| Month of the requested termination date | Share of the charge kept |
|---|---|
| January, February | the whole (100 percent) |
| March, April | 75 percent (0.75) |
| May, June, July, August | 50 percent (0.50) |
| September, October | 75 percent (0.75) |
| November, December | the whole (100 percent) |

The share multiplies the charge, and no figure is rounded before the charge itself. The month read is that of the termination date asked for on the request, not the month the request was received.

*Examples (hypothetical).* A termination date of 31 August keeps 50 percent; 1 September keeps 75 percent; 31 October keeps 75 percent; 1 November keeps the whole.
